timing.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.

timing.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

timing.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
timing.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
timing.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
timing.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageModel.source: Native Firestore inventory with documented document, single-field and composite index formulas; not JSON byte length or billing telemetry

storageTiming.source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
storageTiming.httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
storageTiming.participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.

overhead.note: Unpriced benchmark-only snapshot reads, setup, validation, browser instrumentation and emulator traffic; inspection time excluded from local function samples

storageTiming.realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.
